attendance.note: CMIS counts the meetings a councillor was expected at over a rolling twelve months, so this window moves with the date the page was read. The council publishes how many of the missed meetings were apologised for, and both halves of that figure are shown here.

allowances.note: From the council's published schedule of allowances paid in 2024-25, matched on surname and initial. An allowance is not a salary: it is a set payment for doing the job. The schedule has four money columns — basic allowance, special responsibility, expenses and total — but prints a figure in only three of them for almost everyone, so the basic allowance and the total can be read off it and the middle figure cannot be told apart from expenses. This page therefore shows the basic allowance and the total, and says nothing about special responsibility.

interests.note: Taken from the register this councillor signed on 1 June 2026. The council had this councillor on its April 2026 form. In the pecuniary table that form puts the councillor's answers beside their partner's, and the two columns run together when the file is read as text. The 'other registrable interests' box below it is a single list with no partner column. All five entries in that box are shown. Three jobs are listed in the employment row, across the councillor's column and their partner's, with nothing in the file to say which is whose, so none of them is shown. The full form is linked.

payload.summary: Councillor Hannah Hoechner has represented Nelson ward since 5 May 2023. They sit on 3 of the council's committees and panels: Climate and environment emergency executive panel, Council and Scrutiny committee. The council's committee system records them at 19 of the 23 meetings they were expected at in the 12 months to 8 September 2026. They missed 4, and the council records apologies for all 4.
